why_this_track_exists: Gate 0B is blocked by acquisition provenance, not by the depth itself. No writer for the stored layout exists in any available repository, so alignment and the night intrinsic's stream identity cannot be established from records. Where the repository already holds manually annotated RGB geometry, known pallet dimensions, depth and an intrinsic for the same frame, that gap can be tested empirically instead of documented.

questions.Q1: are the stored depth and cam_K geometrically compatible with manually annotated RGB pallet geometry
questions.Q2: can known pallet geometry distinguish pallet-supporting depth structure from incidental ground or background planes

required_per_frame: manual or reviewed 2D cuboid keypoints exist
population_rule.discovery: enumerate by content, resolving each annotated frame back to its raw recording by image SHA256 rather than by path string, because the import manifest records the GT folder as the source for most frames

leakage_contract.allowed_now: these frames may be used for this sensor question
leakage_contract.forbidden_later: this population must never be reused as an independent confirmation population for method success
leakage_contract.reason: using the same frames to validate the sensor and then to confirm the method would make the confirmation circular

reference_geometry.source: manual 2D keypoints plus the registered physical dimensions
reference_geometry.pose_reconstruction: the existing frozen geometry/PnP contract in this repository; no new solver, no new convention
reference_geometry.existing_geometry_reference_may_be_read: GEOMETRY_RESOLVED_POSE_GT.json may be read for the reference pose, but it is never used to tune anything and Gate 1 tuning against it stays forbidden

A_depth_at_manual_face.shrink_ratio_source: identical to GATE0B_METHOD_LOCK.json, not re-chosen here

B_known_geometry_compatibility.step_1: reconstruct a reference cuboid pose from manual 2D keypoints and known dimensions using the frozen contract
B_known_geometry_compatibility.step_2: project that 3D cuboid into the image
B_known_geometry_compatibility.step_3: compare the measured depth against the depth the reference surface implies
B_known_geometry_compatibility.emphasis: the reference is manual geometry, not a model prediction

C_residual_definitions.primary: for each valid measured depth pixel, the distance between the backprojected 3D point and the manual-reference cuboid surface
C_residual_definitions.secondary: absolute difference in centimetres between measured z and the z the reference surface implies along the same ray

compare: measured depth inside the annotated face interior
depth implied by the reference cuboid surface
depth in the surrounding ground or background ring
D_discriminability.signal_sought: face residual smaller than ring residual

E_boundary_alignment.why_stronger: Gate 0B compared generic RGB Canny edges against depth discontinuities. Here the pallet boundary is known from manual annotation, so the comparison is against the object rather than the whole scene.
E_boundary_alignment.measure: distance from the manual pallet boundary to the nearest depth discontinuity
E_boundary_alignment.reverse_direction: depth edge to manual edge, restricted to a neighbourhood of the manual boundary, because background depth edges otherwise dominate

F_k_role.check: whether manual RGB geometry and depth compatibility come out consistent under the day K and under the night K separately
F_k_role.forbidden_phrasing: COLOR_K_CONFIRMED_BY_CAPTURE, or anything implying acquisition metadata that does not exist

G_scale.question: are the known cuboid dimensions and the depth geometry consistent at metric level under the frozen scale

specification_gap.resolution: the full specification through section 23 was supplied before any measurement ran; this lock is amended, still ahead of every result

verdict_axes.categories_are_closed: no verdict string outside these lists may be written, a rule added because Gate 0B violated exactly that

a_pass_does_not_mean: that depth-assisted correction would improve accuracy. It would mean only that the stored depth is geometrically consistent with manually annotated RGB geometry, which is the evidence Gate 0B could not obtain from records.

all_four_required: stored depth is empirically compatible with manual RGB pallet geometry
the frozen 0.001 scale is not contradicted
the manual pallet surface is measurably better explained by depth than the surrounding background or ground
no repeated systematic RGB-depth boundary displacement
ready_conditions.if_no_defensible_numeric_cut_exists: leave DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY and do not auto-declare READY

leakage_rules_extended.explicit_example_of_what_is_forbidden: seeing the result and then changing the 20 percent shrink to 10 percent

separation_from_gate1.this_track_asks_only: whether the depth measurement contract is trustworthy
